task: A town of 20000 people wants to reduce car traffic in its centre. Which measures would work best, and what are the risks?

nodes.name: Traffic planner
nodes.instructions: Answer as a traffic planner. Propose measures to reduce car traffic in the centre and say how much each is likely to help.

nodes.name: Local shop owner
nodes.instructions: Answer as the owner of a small shop in the town centre. Say how each measure would affect your customers and deliveries.

nodes.name: Resident
nodes.instructions: Answer as a resident who lives in the centre. Say what would improve daily life and what would make it worse.
